visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short brown hair and a light complexion, wearing a white puffy jacket over a gray Nike hooded sweatshirt, stands next to a glossy black Tesla. He smiles and gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera in a clean, modern indoor showroom with glass partitions. (2) The scene transitions to the man standing outdoors on a sidewalk in front of a gray industrial building with a large sign that reads 'KING CART' and '卡特王'. He points toward the entrance while explaining his location. The sky is overcast and the lighting is flat and natural. (3) Inside a brightly lit workshop, two technicians wearing dark clothing are hunched over the front trunk of the black car, performing mechanical work. A wooden table with tissues and personal items is in the foreground. The floor is concrete and the walls are metallic. (4) The man is shown in a different indoor room featuring a decorative crystal chandelier and wood-paneled walls. He holds up one finger and then two to emphasize the specific points of his car modification project while looking confidently at the camera. (5) A close-up shot captures the front hood of the black Tesla as it opens smoothly and automatically, revealing a storage compartment. The car's surface reflects the overhead studio lights, creating bright white streaks on the black paint. (6) A younger man with tattoos on his arms, wearing a green sweatshirt and a black technician's apron, speaks to the camera. He uses descriptive hand movements to explain the benefits of the new car parts. The background contains car posters and shelving. (7) The original man is seen from the waist up sitting in the driver's seat of the car. He points his finger toward an electronic rearview mirror that displays a crisp digital video feed of the road behind. He looks impressed and continues his narration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with an enthusiastic and friendly vlogger tone. Background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a fast tempo around 125 BPM, featuring prominent synthesizers and a driving electronic drum beat. (2) As the speaker moves outdoors, a faint urban ambient noise floor of distant traffic is audible, though the voice remains well-projected and clear. The music continues without interruption, maintaining a consistent energetic vibe throughout the transition. (3) The audio shifts back to a workshop setting where a mechanical whirring sound of a motor and a subtle metallic latch click are heard as the trunk opens. A cartoonish 'Boom' stinger sound effect punctuate the visual action for emphasis. (4) A second male voice, belonging to a technician, enters the mix. His speech is more measured and professional, explaining technical aspects. The background music volume is slightly reduced (ducked) to ensure his technical explanation is clearly heard. (5) The main narrator returns with high vocal arousal and positive valence, expressing satisfaction. The acoustic resonance changes to reflect the enclosed space of the car interior. A quick whoosh transition SFX links various shots of the car's interior features and digital mirror. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's enthusiastic call to action. The music reaches a peak intensity before a final hard cut to silence. The overall signal-to-noise ratio is high, with studio-quality clarity in the vocal tracking.

It highlights high-tech upgrades such as an automated front trunk and a digital rearview mirror, aiming to demonstrate the quality of the shop's specialized electric vehicle services.
